description: This file defines a Flutter widget representing a product listing screen in a shopping app. It includes layout code for the app bar, filter chips, and a grid of product cards, with interaction elements such as a back button and add-to-cart plus buttons.

classes.name: ProductsScreen
classes.description: Main widget representing the product listing page, composing header, filter chips, and product grid.

classes.name: _BackCircle
classes.description: Button widget for navigating back, shows an SVG icon in a circular response.

classes.name: _ChipActive
classes.description: Styled widget representing an active filter chip.

classes.name: _ChipOutline
classes.description: Styled widget representing an inactive or outline filter chip.

classes.name: _ProductCard
classes.description: Widget representing an individual product card with image, title, price, and add button.

classes.name: _PlusButton
classes.description: Stateful widget for the '+' button with animated color change on press.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method of ProductsScreen that constructs the entire layout.

methods.name: onTap
methods.description: Callback functions for interactive elements like back button and add-to-cart buttons.
